sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 861)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across three Yukon frontier adventures starring Paul Sutton as Sergeant Preston on *Challenge of the Yukon* (sled dog rescue in 1947; mine inheritance fraud in 1950; trading post defense in 1951), sensational courtroom evidence on *Famous Jury Trials* (1947), husband-and-wife detective serialization on *Two on a Clue* for General Foods (1945), and comedy music on *The Calumet Show* (1948).
All episode titles strictly adhere to clean canonical naming, with credited performers, sponsor, and network details recorded in the narrative description:
